H1′ CER.rule: CI of bag-of-lines page CER(GLYPHARIS) - 2 x CER(GW-BASE-002) on GDC's clean slice below 0; strict pages, normalised pages and strict source documents must agree

H1′ latency.rule: mean_ci of per-page time(GLYPHARIS, 10 threads) - time(GW-BASE-002, 10 threads), same pages in the same order, below 0
H1′ latency.disclosed: the baseline runs PaddleOCR's two orientation models, as for its accuracy numbers

H5′.rule: CI of strict CER(GDC crops) - 1.5 x CER(HierText validation crops) above 0; line and source-document bootstraps must agree

H8′.rule: GDC crops, strict exact match, 15 equal-mass bins: CI of ECE(T = 2.35) - ECE(T = 1) below 0 (transfers) and of ECE(T = 2.35) - 0.5 x ECE(T = 1) below 0 (by half); line and page bootstraps must agree
